```python
import requests, time
from datetime import datetime

S = requests.Session()
API = "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php"

# Get last revision before July 1, 2023
def get_last_june_oldid(title):
    params = {
        "action": "query",
        "format": "json",
        "prop": "revisions",
        "titles": title,
        "rvstart": "2023-06-30T23:59:59Z",
        "rvdir": "older",
        "rvlimit": 1,
        "rvprop": "ids|timestamp"
    }
    r = S.get(API, params=params)
    data = r.json()
    pages = data.get("query", {}).get("pages", {})
    for _, page in pages.items():
        revs = page.get("revisions")
        if revs:
            return revs[0]["revid"], revs[0]["timestamp"]
    return None, None

oldids = {}
for d in range(1, 32):
    title = f"August {d}"
    oid, ts = get_last_june_oldid(title)
    oldids[title] = {"oldid": oid, "timestamp": ts}
    time.sleep(0.1)

print(oldids)
```

```python
def count_twitter_links(oldid):
```
